evidence.heading: PixelArtistry-Pixal3D-Multiview
evidence.text:
Free & local ComfyUI workflow that turns one prompt into a **4-view character sheet** (front / left / back / right) and feeds it to **Pixal3D Multiview** for a textured 3D mesh. No Nano Banana, no paid API, no custom nodes.

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI)
[](https://www.youtube.com/@PixelArtistry_)

> **Video walkthrough:** [VIDEO LINK – TODO]



*Example output of Step 2: one sheet, four views, same character. The image here is a downscaled copy.*



---

evidence.heading: What it does
evidence.text:
1. **Front view.** Qwen-Image 2.1 turns your prompt into one T-posed front view on a white background.
2. **Turnaround sheet.** Qwen-Image 2.1 Edit takes that front view and draws a single 4096×1024 row: front, left, back, right.
3. **Split into 4 views.** The sheet is cut into four crops. Background removal and a re-centering step turn each one into a 1024×1024 square.
4. **Pixal3D Multiview.** The four views go into Pixal3D as front / left / back / right (fixed 90° steps). It builds the shape, then the texture.
5. **GLB export.** Post-processing, texture baking and a GLB file. Steps 4–5 are unchanged from the official ComfyUI template.

evidence.heading: Requirements
evidence.text:
- **Latest ComfyUI.** Qwen-Image 2.1 and Pixal3D Multiview are core nodes. No custom nodes needed.
- **Disk space:** about 25 GB for the required models, +17.6 GB for the two optional prompt enhancers.
- **VRAM:** around 12 GB in my tests.
- Windows for the model downloader script. On other systems, download the models manually (table below).

evidence.heading: Installation
evidence.text:
1. **Update ComfyUI** to the latest version.
2. **Get the models.** Either run the downloader:

   ```
   download_models_win.bat
   ```

   or pass the ComfyUI folder directly: `download_models_win.bat "C:\path\to\ComfyUI"`.
   The script checks for the `models` folder, skips files you already have, and asks before downloading the optional enhancers.

   Or download manually into the folders below:

   | Model | Size | Target folder |
   |---|---|---|
   | [qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 6.76 GB | `models/diffusion_models` |
   | [pixal3d_multiview_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/diffusion_models/pixal3d_multiview_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 5.2 GB | `models/diffusion_models` |
   | [qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 8.71 GB | `models/text_encoders` |
   | [qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors) | 644 MB | `models/vae` |
   | [trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/vae/trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors) | 1.02 GB | `models/vae` |
   | [trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/vae/trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors) | 904 MB | `models/vae` |
   | [dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/clip_vision/dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors) | 1.13 GB | `models/clip_vision` |
   | [birefnet.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/B

evidence.heading: Usage
evidence.text:
The workflow is split into groups that match the steps above. It also contains notes with the same information.

1. **Step 1 · Text to Image.** Write your character or prop prompt (see the [formula](#the-prompt-formula)). Run once and check the front view. Settings: 1:1, 1 MP, 25 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple. The front view is saved to `output/PixelArtistry/01_front`.
   Tip: while you iterate on Step 1, bypass the later groups (Ctrl+B on the group) so you don't wait for the 3D part every time.
2. **Step 2 · Turnaround sheet.** The front view goes into the Edit node as `<image1>`. Custom size is on: **4096×1024**, so each panel is 1024×1024. Saved to `output/PixelArtistry/02_turnaround_sheet`. If the sheet is wrong, re-roll the seed of this node only.
3. **Step 3 · Split the sheet.** Four crop nodes cut the sheet into front / left / back / right. Background removal plus Crop Image to Mask re-centers each view on a 1024×1024 square. The views are saved to `output/PixelArtistry/03_views/`.
4. **Step 4–5 · Pixal3D Multiview.** Shape, texture, post-processing, texture baking and GLB export. FOV is 20 (the default, recommended for synthetic AI-generated views). The workflow's Save 3D node writes to `output/3d/ComfyUI`.

evidence.heading: The prompt formula
evidence.text:
**[Subject] + [Proportions] + [Outfit & materials] + [Pose] + [Camera & framing] + [Lighting] + [Style] + [Clean-up] + [Background]**

Each slot exists because of what Pixal3D does with the image later. The reason for every slot is in [`prompts/prompt_formula.md`](prompts/prompt_formula.md).

Example prompts, Step 1 and Step 2 each:

- [Character: space mechanic](prompts/character.md) (loaded in the workflow by default)
- [Prop: jetpack](prompts/prop_jetpack.md) (from the workflow notes, paste it in yourself)

Keep `refine_prompt` off in both nodes.

evidence.heading: Why the side-view wording matters
evidence.text:
A true 90° side view of a T-pose looks odd: one arm points straight at the camera, the other is hidden. Image models avoid that and "cheat" to a 3/4 view unless the profile is described explicitly. 3/4 views break Pixal3D Multiview, which expects fixed 90° steps.

So the Step 2 prompt spells out a real profile: exact 90°, which way the face points, only one eye visible, near arm foreshortened, far arm hidden. It also says the camera orbits a static character, so the pose and head direction stay the same in every view.

For props, describe what the back looks like. Otherwise the model invents one.

evidence.heading: What you need
evidence.text: Sonora Studio is the control room, not a one-click installer. It needs a separate machine that actually runs the ACE-Step 1.5 model: either your own computer (ComfyUI) or a rented one (RunPod or Vast.ai). Pick one before you start.

evidence.heading: Minimum for running on your own computer
evidence.text:
| | Minimum | Better |
|---|---|---|
| GPU | NVIDIA with **12 GB VRAM** (the model needs memory offloading and runs slowly) | **16 GB or more**; 20 GB+ avoids offloading |
| Free disk space | **22 GB** for the model files | 30 GB or more |
| System | Windows 10 or 11, or Linux | |
| Software | Node.js 22+, ComfyUI, FFmpeg | Python 3 with the packages in `separator-requirements.txt` (stem separation) |

The VRAM figures come from the [ACE-Step 1.5 model card](https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-turbo) and release notes, not from our own measurements. They describe the ACE-Step project's own app; check your first generation in ComfyUI to see what your card really does. Without a suitable GPU, use RunPod (below) instead.

evidence.heading: What Sonora installs for you, and what it does not
evidence.text:
| Sonora does it | You do it yourself |
|---|---|
| Checks which ACE-Step model files are missing and downloads them (about 19.9 GB, after you confirm), verifying each file's SHA-256 | Install **ComfyUI** (a recent version that includes the ACE-Step 1.5 nodes) and start it |
| Resumes an interrupted download | Install **Node.js 22+** |
| Tells you if a required ComfyUI node is missing | Install **FFmpeg** and make sure it is on your PATH (needed for uploads, editing, stems and export) |
| | Install the Python packages for stem separation (optional) |
| | Install NVIDIA drivers |

Sonora never installs or edits ComfyUI, its custom nodes or its settings.

New to ACE-Step 1.5? The project's own [tutorial and FAQ](https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5/blob/main/docs/en/Tutorial.md) explains how the model works, how to write prompts and lyrics, and answers common questions.

evidence.heading: Quick start (Windows, NVIDIA GPU)
evidence.text: This is the full path for running everything on your own computer. Do the steps in order. Linux works the same way with `npm start`.

evidence.heading: 2. Install and start ComfyUI
evidence.text:
- Download the **Windows portable (NVIDIA)** build from the Releases page of [ComfyUI](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/releases) and extract it to a short path such as `C:\ComfyUI`.
- Start it with `run_nvidia_gpu.bat`. The first start takes a while. Keep that window open: ComfyUI must be running whenever you use Sonora.
- Use a recent ComfyUI that includes the ACE-Step 1.5 nodes. If the nodes are missing, Sonora tells you in **Provider settings**.

evidence.heading: VideoGraph - 无止境
evidence.text:
**LLM 的 After Effects**：面向产品宣传片与音乐人 PV 的本地 AI 视频工程工作台。AI 通过 MCP 建工程、分析歌曲、规划分镜、编写场景和自查；人在审阅室看片、提意见、比较并采用修改。

2026 xihack 大赛参赛项目 · 软件赛道。

**当前版本：0.2.0 · Windows x64 完整工作台**

[下载 Windows 工作台](https://github.com/vediograph-wuzhijing/videograph-validation/releases/download/v0.2.0/VideoGraph-0.2.0-windows-x64.zip) · [发行说明](https://github.com/vediograph-wuzhijing/videograph-validation/releases/tag/v0.2.0) · [校验文件](https://github.com/vediograph-wuzhijing/videograph-validation/releases/download/v0.2.0/VideoGraph-0.2.0-windows-x64.zip.sha256) · [文档中心](docs/README.md)



工程保存源码、素材、时间轴、意见和版本，支持镜头级修改与分段渲染缓存。审阅室图片为界面示例。

evidence.heading: 0.2.0 的核心改进
evidence.text:
| 重点 | 本版能力 |
|---|---|
| 大工程稳定性 | 大任务记录外置、修订数据去重、任务摘要分页；重操作移出 HTTP 主线程，轻量版本轮询与服务状态诊断 |
| 连续画面自查 | filmstrip 返回带时间、拍点和歌词的连续帧拼图；支持约 2 秒 12 帧的局部检查，导演流程要求当前版本动态证据 |
| 快速迭代 | 未提交源码可做类型/初始化着色器检查、静帧和播放预览，不产生任务或修订；共享场景模块一次提交、多镜引用 |
| 引擎基础件 | 相机、世界卡片与投影，天空/海面/水下环境，逐字素动画、独立图层与选择性后期；可通过 MCP 检索 |
| 意见直达 AI | 按工程或镜头读取意见、锚点和保留项；AI 逐条回应，人比较采用，保留人工权限与版本保护 |

另外支持外部节拍、段落和歌词真值输入，以及按明确策略允许长音持续段切点。完整功能与边界见[本版说明](docs/releases/0.2.0.md)。

evidence.heading: Windows 下载与启动
evidence.text:
1. 下载上方 ZIP 和 SHA-256 校验文件，核对校验值后解压到可写目录。
2. 运行 `Doctor.cmd` 检查环境；将 `workbench.example.json` 复制为 `workbench.json`，按[运行手册](docs/OPERATIONS.md#windows-02-工作台与分发)配置工具路径和端口。
3. 运行 `Start-Workbench.cmd`。默认审阅室地址为 <http://127.0.0.1:5188/?view=project>，HTTP 服务为 `127.0.0.1:5191`。
4. AI 客户端使用安装目录的 `MCP.cmd` 作为 stdio 入口；空闲时用 `Stop-Workbench.cmd` 正常停止工作台。

发行包包含 Node、离线 npm 依赖、审阅室、HTTP、65 项 MCP 工具、视频引擎、许可字体、分析适配和源码，无需另装 Node 或执行 `npm ci`。

渲染需要外部 **FFmpeg/ffprobe 与 Edge/Chromium**。自动歌曲分析另需 Python 和模型；这些配置与检查方法统一见[运行手册](docs/OPERATIONS.md)及[分析器环境](analyzer/environment.md)。已有节拍/歌词真值时可跳过模型分析。

evidence.heading: 让 AI 操作工程
evidence.text:
先启动工作台，再由 AI 客户端拉起 MCP。连接参数、工具契约与错误处理见 [MCP 使用指南](docs/MCP-GUIDE.md)。未接 MCP 时，Windows 包也提供 `HTTP-Tools.cmd tools` 查看工具，`HTTP-Tools.cmd call <工具名> args.json` 调用。

仓库内置[制作与恢复技能](.agents/skills/videograph-create/SKILL.md)和 [shotcraft 技法库](skills/shotcraft/SKILL.md)，MCP 也暴露相应 resources。默认制作流程为：

- 开工先检索基础件、特效和转场；有参考作品先看抽帧与运动，再读实现。
- 草稿先检查和预览，只提交改变的镜头；每轮直接读审阅意见并检查连续帧。
- 导出前说明无法验证的播放、聆听等项，交给人确认；AI 自评不代替人工采用。

参考研究、混合媒介、文字 PV 配方和对拍方法见 [PV 制作流程](skills/shotcraft/references/pv-production.md)，可用 `craft_guide({topic:"pv-production"})` 读取。

evidence.heading: 从源码开发
evidence.text:
需要 Node.js 24 和 npm。安装后可启动生产工作台：

```powershell
npm ci
npm run build
npm run workbench -- doctor
npm run workbench -- start
```

开发时使用两个终端分别运行 `npm run service` 和 `npm run dev`，MCP 客户端使用 `npm run mcp`。生产工作台与开发服务选择一种启动方式，端口和实例配置见[运行手册](docs/OPERATIONS.md)。

`npm run check` 执行类型、架构、文档与 portable 检查；完整媒体回归使用 `npm run check:full`，环境要求见[开发与维护](CONTRIBUTING.md)。本版验收记录随 [Release](https://github.com/vediograph-wuzhijing/videograph-validation/releases/tag/v0.2.0) 提供。

evidence.text:
保留 MIDI/假名或 JSON 乐谱、人声候选、外部干轨导入和测量报告等既有入口。**该模块在 0.2.0 冻结，仅修复已确认的 bug**，作为未来探索方向保留。现有模型调用效果尚不可靠，技术管线通过不代表能可靠制作歌声或听感已由人接受。

evidence.heading: 仓库简介
evidence.text: 基于麦当劳 MCP 的权益精算 Skill——按档口与账户权益实时核价，算清这顿值不值、这张卡值不值，一次确认完成点单

evidence.heading: 🧮 麦麦值不值 McWorth
evidence.text:
**基于当前时间和你的账户权益，把最划算的点单方案直接端到你面前**——原本要在 App 里翻菜单、比价格、挑券、选自提还是外送的十几步，压缩成一次确认。







> **🧮 一句话**：用麦当劳 MCP 把点单算成一笔账——**这顿值不值、这张卡值不值、这件大事值不值**，一次确认搞定。所有数字来自核价接口实时返回，不是估算。
>
> **真实首单闭环（真机跑通，非演示）**：说一句"推荐一份早餐" → 早餐档核价 **¥27 → ¥16.1**（省 ¥10.9）→ 预约 07:40 自取 → 支付 → **取餐码 35016 · 订单已完成**。全程 36 分钟，人只做"选方案 + 付钱"两个动作。

evidence.heading: 为什么是它
evidence.text:
在 App 上吃顿"划算的麦当劳"，实际要走十几步：打开 App → 翻菜单找哪个有优惠 → 对比套餐价 → 挑券 → 算是自取便宜还是外送划算 → 下单。而且每个档口菜单都换一遍，早上算好的账中午作废。买了早餐卡的人还得自己记着"这个月回本了没"，犹豫麦金卡的人只能看到"开通享 XX 项权益"的口号，看不到**你常点的那个套餐，持卡到底省多少**。

麦麦值不值把这条流程压缩成一次确认：**时间和账户信息它都知道**——档口几点开几时关、你有什么卡、卡价商品是哪些、常点是什么、外送划不划算，全部由 MCP 接口实时算好，方案带账端到你面前，你只剩选。所有数字不是估算：

| 场景 | 实测样例 | 原价 | 实付 | 省 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 早餐档 · 自提 | 吉士蛋麦满分组合（早餐卡 6 折） | ¥12.0 | **¥7.2** | ¥4.8 |
| 跨档 · 自提 | 麦咖啡™冰美式（早餐卡价全天生效） | ¥19.0 | **¥9.9** | ¥9.1 |
| 下午茶 · 自提 | 马苏里拉拉丝芝士条（促销） | ¥15.0 | **¥11.0** | ¥4.0 |
| 办卡 · 随单购 | 巨无霸四件套 + 麦金卡体验卡（15天） | ¥68.4 | **¥41.9** | **¥26.5** |
| 外送 · 麦金卡专享 | 全明星双人分享餐 8 件套（免配价） | ¥115.5 | **¥54.9** | ¥60.6 |
| 外送 · 多人分享餐 | 加牛欢享四人餐（含配送 ¥6 + 打包 ¥2.8） | ¥124.8* | **¥124.8** | ¥80.2* |
| 大事 · 主题派对 | 疯狂动物城主题（10 人档） | — | **¥580** | ¥58/人 |
| 积分兑换 | 圆筒冰淇淋（100 积分兑 ¥3.9 商品） | ¥5.0 | **100 积分** | — |

\* 多人分享餐为外送菜单促销价（划线价口径），外送还需支付配送费——"值不值"永远合并履约成本计算。样例价格随门店/时段浮动，Skill 输出一律以实时核价为准。

关键一行：花 ¥9.9 随单购一张麦金卡体验卡，**这一单立刻省回 ¥26.5，净赚 ¥16.6**。这不是营销话术，是核价接口盖章的数字。

evidence.heading: 三层能力
evidence.text:
**① 这顿值不值 —— 推荐计划，每天用**
> "中午吃啥" → 档口感知（还剩几分钟）→ 按**档口 × 履约方式矩阵**出推荐计划：早餐档推早餐卡专区（6 折组合 + 咖啡 ¥9.9）、正餐推 1+1 随心配 / 麦金卡专享、周末推麦麦周末与多人分享餐——自提、外送各给方案，每条带账。
> 履约双方案并行：**到店自取 / 预约自取**（睡前订好，明早路上拿）vs **麦乐送**（独立核价，配送成本算进"值不值"；配送时长过长直接否决外送）。
> 配合定时任务：工作日早上一张"早餐决策卡"，回复一个数字才下单。

**② 这张卡值不值 —— 双卡经营，杀手锏**
> **早餐卡**（已办）：每顿报账"原价 ¥27 → 卡价 ¥16.2"，回本进度条 + 剩余天数预警，"还差 ¥x 回本、还能吃 n 个早餐档"。
> **麦金卡**（未办）：办卡决策器——"花 ¥9.9 体验卡，这一单立刻省 ¥26.5，净赚 ¥16.6"。开卡后自动转入"用满经营"，卡一旦充值，"不用就不划算"会让偶然顾客变成长期客户。

**③ 这件大事值不值 —— 低频高值**
> "主题派对 / 体验营" → 19 个在售主题（¥45–198/人，覆盖约 280 城），城市→门店→日期→场次→一笔总账，确认后下单。
> "积分能换啥" → 积分余额 + 可兑换清单 + 性价比账。

**底座：实付账本 + 本地记忆**——每一单的省额写入本地记忆库，喂给推荐计划与办卡决策器，越用越懂你；另有定时任务协议（早餐决策卡 / 卡到期提醒 / 晚间预约建议），详见 [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)。

evidence.heading: 使用示例（真实对话流）
evidence.text:
**场景 A · 工作日早上 8 点，定时任务推送（每天自动发生）**
```
🤖 ⏰ 早餐档 10:15 截止，还有约 2h15m（1人 · 预算 ¥20）
   🏆 🧮 就这单：双层原味板烧鸡腿麦满分套餐（你的常点）
      里面有：双层原味板烧鸡腿麦满分 + 脆薯饼 + 鲜萃冰咖
      原价 ¥27 → 卡价 ¥16.2，省 ¥10.8 ｜ 本月已省 ¥86.4
   备选：吉士蛋麦满分组合 ¥7.2（卡价 6 折）
   回复"1"预约 08:50 自取 ｜ "2"配送到公司 ｜ "换一个"看备选
👤 1
🤖 已按 08:50 预约自取确认：实付 ¥16.2（卡价）。
   取餐时不用排队，出门直接拿走。
```
> 价值：你没打开 App，没翻菜单，没对比价格——一条消息，省 ¥10.8，上班路上顺手拿。

**场景 B · "麦金卡值不值？"（办卡决策）**
```
🤖 🧮 这张卡：麦金卡体验卡（15 天），¥9.9
   单笔实测：巨无霸四件套 原价 ¥58.5 → 持卡 ¥32.0，省 ¥26.5
   这一单净省：¥16.6
   判定：值。你过去 30 天点了 4 次四件套，全程持卡约省 ¥100+。
👤 那开一张
🤖 已确认随单购：麦金卡体验卡 + 巨无霸四件套，合计实付 ¥41.9（原价 ¥68.4）。
   卡已记入你的权益档案，15 天内每顿我都会帮你算回本进度。
```
> 价值：办卡从拍脑袋变成一笔账。¥9.9 当顿回本——这是核价接口盖章的数字，不是营销话术。

**场景 C · "中午吃啥，30 以内"（随手一问）**
```
🤖 🧮 就这单：马苏里拉拉丝芝士条 + 麦咖啡冰美式
   原价 ¥34 → 实付 ¥20.9，省 ¥13.1（促销+早餐卡价，咖啡卡价全天有效）
   为什么是它：下午茶档折扣最深的两件，合计卡在 ¥30 内
   ⏰ 下午茶档 16:45 结束，还剩 1h42m
   到店自取 ¥20.9 ｜ 麦乐送另核（外送菜单价更高 + 配送费）——顺路自取更划算
```
> 价值：给的是结论和账，不是 20 个商品的列表。连"外卖费会不会吃掉折扣"都替你算好了。

**更多入口**：睡前说一句"订明早的早餐"（预约自取）、"订个主题派对"、"积分能换啥"——同一套核价与确认流程，见 [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)。

evidence.heading: 架构
evidence.text:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    U["👤 用户: 中午吃啥 / 麦金卡值不值 / 主题派对"]
    subgraph S["🧮 麦麦值不值 McWorth"]
        direction LR
        A["⏰ 档口感知早餐·午餐·下午茶·夜市·宵夜"]
        B["🧾 卡价核价discountType → calculate-price"]
        C["💳 办卡决策器canWithOrder + withOrder"]
        D["🎂 大事账本派对 6 步链 + 积分兑换"]
        L[("📒 记忆库data/memory.json")]
    end
    M["麦当劳 MCPmcp.mcd.cn · 20 工具"]

    U --> S
    A --> B
    B --> C
    C <--> L
    B <--> M
    C <--> M
    D <--> M
    S -->|"结论 + 一笔账"| U
```

**一次对话，三个时间维度**：档口管"现在"，账本管"过去"，决策器管"未来"。完整工具编排见 [MCP_INTEGRATION.md](MCP_INTEGRATION.md)。

evidence.heading: 快速开始（本地部署，以 WorkBuddy 为例）
evidence.text:
**前置条件**
- 麦当劳中国大陆会员，并在 [open.mcd.cn/mcp](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp) 申请到 **MCP Token**（本 Skill 的全部数据都来自这个官方接口）
- 安装 [WorkBuddy](https://www.workbuddy.cn)（也兼容 Cherry Studio / Cursor 等任意支持 MCP 的客户端）

evidence.heading: 2. 配置 MCP Token（环境变量，勿硬编码）
evidence.text:
```bash
export MCD_MCP_TOKEN="你的token"
```
> macOS 可写入 `~/.zshrc` 永久生效；Windows 在「系统环境变量」里添加。WorkBuddy 启动时会读取该变量，**Token 永远不进仓库**。

evidence.heading: 这是什么
evidence.text:
**Stanford CS 329Z《Engineering AI Agents》** 是斯坦福 2026 年秋季开设的研究生课程(授课:Diyi Yang、Michael Ryan 等,Stanford NLP Group),从 ReAct、RAG、MCP、记忆系统、多智能体,一路讲到测试时计算、数据工程、评测、安全与编程智能体——恰好是当前 AI 工程方向最抢手的一套能力栈,开课消息公布后在社区引发了大量关注。

本仓库是这个课程的**非官方中文学习站**:把课程公开的全部阅读材料翻译成中文,做成可在线阅读的静态网站,**完全免费、无广告、无追踪**。

| 收录内容 | 数量 | 形式 |
|---|---|---|
| 课程必读/推荐论文 | **35 篇全部完成逐段中英对照全译** | 每段英文原文 + 中文全译左右分栏,共 **2,035** 个对照段、约 **45 万** 中文字 |
| 工程博客 / 规范文档 | 14 篇 | 全文中译(含 MCP 规范、Anthropic 工程博客等) |
| 背景解读 | 1 篇 | 全文中译(CS329A 免费公开课程背景长文) |
| 课程讲义 slides | 持续同步 | 官网每放出一讲即收录 PDF 原件(已收录 Lecture 1–9);HW1 讲义与完整仓库均已镜像 |
| PDF / HTML 原件 | 49 篇全部收录 | `originals/` 目录,在线可读 |

> 35 篇论文的**全文逐段对照**全部完成——不是摘要式"精读笔记",是从 Abstract 到 Conclusion(多数含实质附录)的完整翻译,参考文献列表保留原文。

git clone https://github.com/athlonk8/cs329z.git
cd cs329z/source
pip install -r ../requirements.txt   # 只有 markdown 一个依赖

evidence.heading: 仓库简介
evidence.text: 开源可私有化的用户行为分析。Self-hosted user behavior analytics on ClickHouse and ClkLog. Events, funnels, retention, dashboards. AGPL-3.0.

evidence.heading: Candela
evidence.text:
**Turn user behavior into decisions.**

An open-source, self-hosted user-behavior analytics platform. Understand what users do, where they drop off, and whether they return—then track the changes with dashboards and alerts on your own server.

**Event analysis · Funnels · Retention · Cohorts · Dashboards & alerts**

**English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) · [13 interface languages](#languages) · [Fully AI-written](#fully-ai-written-vibe-coding)

**[Quick start](#quick-start) · [Core features](#core-features) · [Product tour](#capabilities) · [Architecture](#architecture) · [Deployment guide](#deploy)**



*Save activity, conversion, revenue, and retention as reusable analysis cards. View, filter, and share them on a dashboard. Screenshots come from a running installation; some still show the earlier ClkLog branding. Dashboard and event names are user-defined.*

Built alongside **ClkLog Community Edition**: ClkLog handles collection and basic reports; Candela adds behavioral analytics, collaboration, and governance. Both consume the same Kafka event stream, with separate analytics databases. **Community images and table definitions stay unchanged.** The optional AI analysis assistant is off by default.

evidence.heading: Core features
evidence.text:
| Your question | What Candela provides |
|---|---|
| What do users do, and which behaviors are growing? | **Event analysis**: counts, unique users, aggregations, property breakdowns, and trends |
| Where do users leave between signup and payment? | **Funnels**: step conversion, drop-off, and conversion windows |
| Do new users come back after a few days? | **Retention**: start and return events, daily cohorts, and retention trends |
| Which people need a closer look? | **Cohorts and timelines**: condition / SQL / ID cohorts, tags, and individual behavior |
| How can the team keep following the business? | **Dashboards, metrics, and alerts**: saved cards and notifications across channels |
| What if the standard analysis models do not cover my question? | **Custom SQL and optional AI**: read-only queries, charts, and analysis of the current page context |

A tracking catalog, data-quality checks, dimension tables, project-level permissions, and 13 interface languages support everyday use. Define your own events and properties for Web, App, mini-program, and other product analytics.

evidence.heading: 1. Prepare a server
evidence.text:
This path uses a **single-server Docker Compose deployment**. Run the commands from the repository root on your workstation. You need:

- An **AlmaLinux 9** server with SSH key access as root; the recorded deployment was tested on AlmaLinux 9.6.
- Recommended **4 CPU cores / 16 GiB RAM / 40 GB or more disk**, with inbound port `80` open.
- Git, SSH, and rsync on the workstation; access to image registries, OS package repositories, and npm from the server. See [Prerequisites](#prerequisites) for mirror settings.

evidence.heading: 2. Deploy and verify
evidence.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ac1261692159/candela.git
cd candela
export HOST=root@your-server  # Replace with your SSH target

# In order: middleware → ClkLog standard mode → Candela
bash scripts/standalone-test-env/deploy-remote.sh mw
bash scripts/standalone-test-env/deploy-remote.sh clklog
bash scripts/standalone-test-env/candela/deploy-remote.sh docker

# Both suites must pass, including reporting and row-count checks
bash scripts/standalone-test-env/candela/deploy-remote.sh verify
bash scripts/standalone-test-env/deploy-remote.sh verify
```

The scripts install runtime components, build the applications, and initialize the databases. First-run time depends on downloads and builds. Steps are idempotent and can be repeated; AI setup is optional.

evidence.heading: 3. Log in and run your first analysis
evidence.text:
Open **`http://<server-ip>/sa/`** and sign in as `admin`. The scripts generate the initial password on the target, in the `ADMIN_INIT_PASSWORD` entry of `/data/app/candela/configs/candela.env`. Read it in a controlled terminal on the target; do not commit or share that file. ClkLog Community is at `http://<server-ip>/`.

1. Select a project and open the **integration guide**. Follow its instructions for the endpoint, project identifier, and token; download an SDK example.
2. Run the example or send your own event. Confirm it arrives in **Debug**; first data may take time to appear.
3. Open **event analysis**, select an event, time range, and metric, then inspect the result.
4. Save the result as a **dashboard card**. Add a metric alert when you want ongoing monitoring.

SDK examples: [`examples/report-sdk/`](examples/report-sdk/). Protocol: [reporting specification](docs/architecture/reporting-protocol.md). The screenshots show example events and dashboards; connect your data to build your own analyses.

Already running ClkLog standard mode, need native processes, or want custom directories? See the [deployment guide](#deploy) and [deployment design](docs/architecture/candela-deploy-two-paths.md).

evidence.heading: Find your way
evidence.text:
| Next step | Go to |
|---|---|
| Explore actual screens and feature details | [Capabilities](#capabilities) |
| Understand the data flow and internal responsibilities | [Architecture](#architecture) |
| Configure, upgrade, roll back, or troubleshoot | [Deploy](#deploy) · [Configuration and secrets](#configuration-and-secrets) |
| Develop locally or contribute | [Local development](#local-development) · [Repository layout](#repository-layout) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Read about AI-written development | [Fully AI-written and CDD](#fully-ai-written-vibe-coding) |
| Take over the project or find design documents | [Documentation](#documentation) · [Handoff](docs/project/handoff-candela-new-repo.md) · [File index](INDEX.md) |

---

evidence.heading: Prerequisites
evidence.text:
| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Target | AlmaLinux 9 (RHEL 9 family is the same), root login, inbound `80` open (optional `8123` if clients should reach ClickHouse directly) |
| Workstation | SSH to the target with key auth already set up (the scripts `ssh` and `rsync` the source, then run remotely) |
| Software | The scripts install Docker and nginx. The native path also needs EPEL (the script configures it; the machine must be able to reach an EPEL mirror) |
| Network | Must be able to pull images. Base images come from `public.ecr.aws/docker/library/*`. ClkLog images come from `registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/clklog/*` |
| Capacity | At least 4 cores and 16 GiB is the recommendation (15 GiB has been shown to work). Memory caps are set explicitly for a small machine |
| Disk | At least 40 GB (images are about 2 GB; the rest is ClickHouse data and logs) |

Two default deploy roots: Candela scripts accept `BASE_DIR` / `MW_BASE_DIR`; the middleware and community remote entry accepts `BASE_DIR` for its own root.

- `<MW_BASE_DIR>` = `/data/clklog-oss-test` — middleware and community (data, config, secrets, scripts)
- `<BASE_DIR>` = `/data/app/candela` — analytics platform (releases, config, secrets, image recipes)

> On a machine outside China, or behind a proxy, override `APT_MIRROR=` (empty uses the image's own Debian mirrors), `NPM_REGISTRY=https://registry.npmjs.org`, `NODE_IMAGE=`, and `NGINX_IMAGE=`.
>
> ClkLog Community images are pulled from `registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/clklog/*` by default. If that registry is unreachable, use a proxy, or mirror the images and change `CK_REG` in the deploy scripts. Official base images come from `public.ecr.aws/docker/library/*`.

github_projects.name: ComfyUI-Olm-SoL-Refiner
github_projects.description: Experimental ComfyUI nodes for NVIDIA's SoL-Refiner
github_projects.description_zh: NVIDIA SoL-Refiner 的实验性 ComfyUI 节点。

evidence.heading: 仓库简介
evidence.text: Experimental ComfyUI nodes for NVIDIA's SoL-Refiner

evidence.heading: Olm SoL Refiner for ComfyUI
evidence.text:
Experimental ComfyUI nodes for NVIDIA's
[SoL Refiner MiniMax-H3 checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-Model/SoL-Refiner-LTX-2.5-for-MiniMax-H3).
Refine and upscale video using decoded frames and a text prompt. Input does not
need to come from LTX, and no MiniMax model or latents are required.

Created by [Olli Sorjonen](https://github.com/o-l-l-i) · [X](https://x.com/Olmirad)



**Experimental:** this is generative refinement, and details can change.
Local tests showed changes to facial features, clothing patterns and jewelry.
Check the result against your source when likeness or detail preservation matters.

evidence.heading: Installation
evidence.text:
From your ComfyUI `custom_nodes` directory:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/o-l-l-i/ComfyUI-Olm-SoL-Refiner.git
```

Install dependencies **using your ComfyUI Python environment**, then restart ComfyUI:

```sh
python -m pip install -r ComfyUI-Olm-SoL-Refiner/requirements.txt
```

Tested on Windows with ComfyUI 0.31.0, Python 3.13, PyTorch 2.13 / CUDA 13,
and an RTX 5090 with 32 GB VRAM and 128 GB system RAM. Smaller GPUs and other
operating systems have not been validated. Requirements include a pinned
Diffusers revision and Triton 3.7 for Windows; match Triton to your PyTorch version.

Download the complete
[model repository](https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-Model/SoL-Refiner-LTX-2.5-for-MiniMax-H3)
(approximately 71 GB) and keep its folders together:

```text
ComfyUI/models/sol_refiner/SoL-Refiner-LTX-2.5-for-MiniMax-H3/
    model_index.json
    connectors/          diffusion_decoder/    latent_upsampler/
    scheduler/           text_encoder/         tokenizer/
    transformer/         vae/
```

Existing `diffusers` or `sol_refiner` paths in `extra_model_paths.yaml` also
work. Point them at the **parent directory** containing the model folder, for
example:

```yaml
external_models:
  sol_refiner: E:/Models
```

With that example, the model belongs in
`E:/Models/SoL-Refiner-LTX-2.5-for-MiniMax-H3/`. Existing `diffusers` entries
need no additional configuration. The loader lists immediate subfolders whose
names contain `sol` and that contain `model_index.json`; keep the original model
folder name. Restart ComfyUI after changing model paths.

The nodes load local files only and do not modify the weights or download
additional models.

evidence.heading: Usage
evidence.text:
Open the [example workflow](workflows/video_refinement.json), select or upload
your video in **Load Video**, and replace the placeholder prompt with a
description of the visible scene and action.

1. **Load Video → Get Video Components** provides frames, audio and FPS.
2. **SoL Refiner Loader (Olm)** selects the model and precision.
3. **SoL Refine Video (Olm)** processes the frames at your chosen output size.
4. **Create Video → Save Video** combines the result with the original audio and FPS.

For an 864 × 480 input, set width and height to **1728 × 960** for 2× output.
The refiner returns a normal `IMAGE` batch; other video-loading and saving nodes
can be used too. Frame count and FPS are preserved. Audio bypasses the model.

| Setting | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `precision` | Start with `fp8`. `bf16` uses more memory; `nvfp4` is an experimental Blackwell option. Quantization applies to large transformer layers. |
| `decoder_backend` | Use `flex` for the tested Windows setup. First use or new shapes require compilation. `natten` needs a separate installation and is untested here. |
| `keep_models_in_ram` | Off by default. Enable for faster reruns at the cost of keeping tens of GB of CPU weights. |
| Decoder tiles | Smaller tiles can reduce decoder memory, but can affect texture and seams. |
| Seeds | Refinement and decoding have separate noise seeds. |

Models use ComfyUI's memory management and are offloaded between stages and
after execution, including cancellation. The text encoder remains large even
with a quantized transformer. `--novram` is unsupported. Start with a short clip;
compilation and decoding can take considerably longer than the refinement step.

evidence.heading: Example comparison
evidence.text:
The middle frame (index 79, 3.292 s) of a 158-frame, 24 fps clip. Left: 864 × 480
source enlarged with Lanczos to match the 1728 × 960 output on the right.
Click the image to inspect it at full size.

Settings: FP8, Flex attention, seeds 0/0, decoder tiles 384 px / 32 frames.
The original text prompt was supplied; the image reference mentioned in that
prompt was not an additional model input. This is one local example, not a
benchmark of the model's overall quality. A still frame does not show temporal
consistency.

evidence.heading: Credits
evidence.text:
Model and research: [NVIDIA / SoL Refiner](https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Sol-Refiner/).
This is an independent ComfyUI integration. It supports the **LTX-2.5 MiniMax-H3**
package, which is separate from the original paper's LTX-2.3 checkpoints.

See [NVIDIA's H3 instructions](https://github.com/NVlabs/Sana/tree/sol-engine/models/sol-refiner/MiniMax-H3)
and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for source attribution.

evidence.heading: README
evidence.text:
Know what's around you, what you're standing on, and what you're carrying — while you fly.



  
  
  
  


---

ED Outrider reads your Elite Dangerous journals as you play and keeps one browser tab up to date
with the things an explorer keeps alt-tabbing to find out: **whether anyone has been to the
systems near you, what's in the one you're in, what your unsold data is worth, and whether you're
about to jump away from something you'll regret leaving.**

It runs on your own machine. It asks [Spansh](https://spansh.co.uk) (and
[EDSM](https://www.edsm.net) as a backup) what the community already knows about the systems
around you, then layers your own scans on top. Nothing is uploaded unless you switch on sharing with
[EDDN, EDSM or Inara](docs/guide/uploads.md), as EDMC does. A tablet can sit beside you as a cockpit
display ([ED Outrider for Android](https://github.com/weslocke/ED-Outrider-Android), or any browser), and Outrider can
also run 24/7 on a home server in Docker.


  



On a 27-inch monitor (2560×1440)

evidence.heading: 仓库简介
evidence.text: f(t)函数: LLM制作的动画集. 自由软件, 自由视频.

evidence.heading: f(t)
evidence.text:
f(t) 用大语言模型协助制作科普与项目介绍视频。首要任务是把内容讲清楚：事实可靠，问题值得回答，叙事让观众跟得上。视觉、动画和声音为内容服务。

好的文档是制作的一部分：事实能追溯，文案能通读，取舍有理由，接手的人知道下一步做什么。这里公开视频的事实依据、文案、审稿记录、动画源码与制作工具。名字来自画面本身——任意一帧都是时间 t 的纯函数 f(t)。

成片为 1920×1080、60 帧/秒，发布在 [哔哩哔哩](https://space.bilibili.com/68328330) 与 [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@waterrun1978)。全部作品、制作状态、发布记录与评分见 **[片单](videos/README.md)**。

evidence.heading: 自由软件，自由视频
evidence.text:
本项目对有权授权的源码、文档、视听作品采用 **GPL-3.0-or-later**。可以研究、修改、重新制作和再发布；分发受 GPL 覆盖的改编作品时，须履行相应的源码与许可义务。**本项目交给第三方制作的成果也必须开源**，交付可编辑材料、制作步骤及相应许可，不能只交 MP4。范围与交付方式见[开源交付与第三方许可](docs/reference/third-party.md)。

我们以**共产主义精神**组织协作：知识共享，生产资料公开，各尽所能，劳动如实署名，改进回到公共。工具、方法与失败的教训都应帮助后来者继续工作。详见[宗旨与原则](docs/principles.md)。

evidence.heading: 怎样做出来的
evidence.text:
- **内容大于形式。** 事实、解释与叙事是作品的核心，视听表达为理解服务。先确定问题、取证并写好文案，确认后再铺开制作。流程见[制作周期](docs/process.md)。
- **画面是时间的纯函数。** 每部视频是一段以 t 为唯一输入的 HTML 动画。不用 CSS 动画、定时器与回调，任意一帧都能独立渲染，多个无头浏览器并行出帧，再由 ffmpeg 编码封装。
- **旁白决定时间。** 旁白逐句合成，取回每个词被读到的时刻；动画挂在「某句里某个词」上，文案一改，画面自动重排。同一套场景代码可以配多种语言。
- **事实有出处。** 画面与旁白里的每一项事实都记在该片的 `research/FACTS.md`；画面上的字节、数字、终端回显由脚本从实验数据生成。
- **人审定内容。** 文案经校对者明确确认后才配音；成片由策划者观看、试听并同意后交付。
- **自动检查辅助审查。** 工具检查版面、规格与确定性；内容是否可靠、叙事是否清楚、声音是否合适，仍要通过读稿、观看和试听判断。
- **声音由程序合成。** 配乐与音效不用外部素材，混音是确定性的。
- **分工按能力。** 人负责选题、审定与评价；准备方完成取证与文案，制作方负责视听制作。片尾记录实际贡献：人使用本人选定的公开署名，模型注明准确型号和版本。

github_projects.name: ReSAIL
github_projects.description: Official implementation of “ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation”
github_projects.description_zh: “ReSAIL：缓解迭代智能体自蒸馏崩溃”的官方实现

evidence.heading: 仓库简介
evidence.text: Official implementation of “ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation”

evidence.heading: README
evidence.text:
ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative
  Agent Self-Distillation



  
    
  
  
    
  
  
    
  
  
    
  
  
    
  



  News ·
  Motivation ·
  Overview ·
  Quick Start


---

**ReSAIL** (**Retentive and Selective Augmentation for Iterative Self-Distillation**) mitigates performance collapse in iterative agent self-distillation. It is a plug-in augmentation that combines **trajectory-balanced selective distillation** with **privileged retention** to improve learning within each cycle and preserve behavior conditioned on privileged information (PI) as the student becomes the next teacher.

On **ALFWorld** and **TextCraft**, ReSAIL sustains substantial gains with **Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B** over **three deployment cycles**. Adding ReSAIL to the corresponding **SDPO and OEL** baselines improves final-cycle success rates by an **average of 22.5 percentage points**.

> Our findings provide the **first evidence** that a more robust learning mechanism can effectively **mitigate performance collapse** in iterative agent self-distillation over deployment trajectories.

evidence.heading: News
evidence.text:
- **[2026.10]** We release the code for **ReSAIL**, built on [slime](https://github.com/THUDM/slime), with training and evaluation scripts included.
- **[2026.09]** Eight Cycle-3 checkpoints for **ALFWorld** and **TextCraft**, with **Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B**, are now public in the [ReSAIL Collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/HuggingJin/resail-6ab8e06426ca99d03aabfa0f).
- **[2026.09]** Our paper is available on [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39306).

evidence.heading: Motivation
evidence.text:
Iterative self-distillation lets agents learn from successive deployments, offering a path toward **recursive self-improvement (RSI)**. Yet repeating the learning cycle does not guarantee continued improvement: our experiments with SDPO and OEL reveal **collapse in deployment performance** alongside **declining task competence with privileged information (PI)**.

PI is extra context available during training and omitted during deployment. Each updated model must both act without PI and provide PI-conditioned supervision as the next teacher. The base distillation objective trains the student only without PI, leaving its PI-conditioned behavior without an explicit preservation objective.


  

Figure 1. ALFWorld OOD with Qwen3-4B. (a) Deployment success with and without ReSAIL. (b) PI-conditioned success of the original methods, with tasks and PI held fixed across cycles. C0 is the shared initial model; error bars show standard deviation across three decoding seeds.

This motivates two questions:

1. **Which interaction steps should be prioritized for distillation?** We prioritize steps where PI most strongly changes the teacher's predictions, measuring this PI sensitivity using Jensen–Shannon divergence between teacher predictions with and without PI.
2. **What happens when the student becomes the next teacher?** Preserving the student's PI-conditioned behavior maintains the supervision used in the next cycle.

evidence.heading: Overview
evidence.text:
ReSAIL addresses these questions with two complementary modules: **Trajectory-Balanced Selective Distillation (TBSD)** for learning within each cycle, and **Privileged Retention (PR)** for retaining PI-conditioned behavior across cycles.


  

Figure 2 from the paper. ReSAIL adds selective distillation and privileged retention to the base self-distillation loop.

| Component | Role |
| --- | --- |
| **[Sensitivity-Guided Selection (SGS)](slime_plugins/agent_tasks/common/algorithms/sgs.py)** | Select steps where privileged context most changes the frozen teacher's predictions. |
| **[Trajectory Loss Balancing (TLB)](slime_plugins/agent_tasks/common/algorithms/tlb.py)** | Balance the selected distillation losses across source trajectories. |
| **[Privileged Retention (PR)](slime_plugins/agent_tasks/common/algorithms/pr.py)** | Retain the teacher's privileged-view behavior on both selected and unselected steps. |

SGS and TLB together form **TBSD**. **PR** regularizes the student's PI-conditioned output distributions toward those of the frozen teacher at both selected and unselected steps. See the [method guide](docs/method.md) for the loss, sampling, and implementation details.

evidence.heading: Supported experiments
evidence.text:
| | Included |
| --- | --- |
| **Tasks** | ALFWorld · TextCraft |
| **Base models** | Qwen3-4B · Qwen3-8B |
| **ReSAIL integrations** | OEL + ReSAIL (`resail`) · SDPO + ReSAIL (`sdpo_resail`) |
| **Baselines** | ReAct · RFT · GRPO · EPD · SDPO · OEL |
| **Training** | Three cycles, with final-checkpoint evaluation after each cycle |
| **Shared inputs** | Collect C1 once per task and base model; reuse it across methods |

ReAct evaluates the base model once. The other methods train over C1–C3. All combinations and command options are listed in the [experiment catalog](docs/experiment_catalog.md).

evidence.heading: 1. Prepare the environment and inputs
evidence.text:
Follow the [environment guide](docs/environment.md) to build the container and prepare a matching base checkpoint. Then download the [models and task data](docs/inputs.md):

- [ALFWorld setup](slime_plugins/agent_tasks/alfworld/README.md)
- [TextCraft setup](slime_plugins/agent_tasks/textcraft/README.md)

The main configurations use **8 GPUs**. Run the commands below from the repository root on the **host**; the launcher executes the workload inside the prepared container.

Experiment logging is offline by default and requires no W&B account.

evidence.heading: 2. Run a main experiment
evidence.text:
Train OEL + ReSAIL with Qwen3-4B on ALFWorld:

```bash
bash scripts/launch_experiment.sh alfworld-4b-resail-001 -- \
  bash scripts/experiments/text_cycles.sh \
    --task alfworld --model 4b --method resail --mode paper
```

This command collects fresh C1 trajectories, then completes training and evaluation for all three cycles. Change `--task`, `--model`, and `--method` to select another experiment. Each later cycle collects data using that method's preceding checkpoint.

kind_reason.text: 迭代智能体自蒸馏论文实现。

summary.text: ReSAIL 用选择性蒸馏和特权信息能力保留，研究缓解智能体多轮自蒸馏中的部署性能崩塌。

value.text: 兼顾学生当前学习效率和作为下一轮教师时的监督能力，避免反复训练退化。

mechanism.text: 轨迹平衡的选择性蒸馏关注特权上下文影响较大的步骤，特权保留模块维持带额外信息的行为；每轮用前轮模型采集新数据。

limitations.text: 公开实验主要为 ALFWorld、TextCraft 与 Qwen3-4B/8B 的三轮训练，主配置使用八张 GPU，不能外推到所有长期智能体。

evidence.heading: JARVIS
evidence.text:
JARVIS is the desktop assistant created by **VORNEX**.

It is built to work with your computer directly — opening applications, navigating interfaces, handling files, using the web, carrying out multi-step tasks, and checking whether important actions actually succeeded.

The idea is simple:

> **Tell JARVIS what you need. Let it handle the computer.**

---

evidence.heading: What it can do
evidence.text:
| Area | Capabilities |
|---|---|
| Desktop | Control applications, windows, keyboard and mouse |
| Files | Find, read, organize and work with files |
| Web | Search the web and work with supported web tasks |
| Communication | Work with supported messaging workflows |
| Media | Open and interact with supported media services |
| System | Monitor system health and handle supported recovery |
| Development | Assist with coding and development workflows |
| Memory | Maintain useful context and learned information |
| Remote | Provide an authenticated remote dashboard |
| Safety | Confirm sensitive actions and verify important results |

JARVIS is designed around **general desktop interaction**.

Normal computer tasks do not depend on having a separate custom script for every application. When an application exposes standard desktop controls, JARVIS can work with those controls through its general interaction system.

---

evidence.heading: How it works
evidence.text:
JARVIS follows a simple loop:

**Observe → Understand → Act → Verify**

It can inspect the current desktop, determine what needs to happen, perform the required interaction, and verify the result before treating the task as complete.

If success cannot be established, JARVIS is designed to stop rather than simply claim that the task worked.

---

- Gemini API key
- Microphone and audio output

evidence.heading: Overview
evidence.text:
Tomechat is a chatbot that connects to remote model services through OpenAI-compatible APIs (or the Google Gemini native SDK, via `MODEL_PLATFORM_TYPE=gemini`) and implements knowledge-base RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) chat with FAISS vector search on top of the LangChain framework.

Architecture:

- **FastAPI backend** — model proxy, RAG, knowledge-base management, database
- **Next.js frontend** — the only WebUI; talks to the backend API
- **SQLite + FAISS** — knowledge-base metadata storage and vector retrieval

Model call boundary: FastAPI is the only model gateway. The Next.js frontend never talks to model providers directly and never holds provider keys.

evidence.heading: Features
evidence.text:
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| LLM chat | Call remote LLMs through OpenAI-compatible APIs (or the Gemini native SDK) |
| Knowledge-base RAG | Local knowledge-base Q&A based on FAISS vector retrieval |
| Search engine chat | Web search–augmented chat via Tavily (or self-hosted SearxNG) |
| Knowledge-base management | CRUD, document vectorization, FAISS index |

evidence.heading: Model Services
evidence.text:
Remote model services are accessed through OpenAI-compatible APIs, or through the Google native SDK for Gemini. The LLM service and the embedding service are configured independently and may use different providers (see `.env.example`):

**LLM service**

* `MODEL_API_BASE` / `MODEL_API_KEY` — provider API base URL and key
* `MODEL_CHAT_MODEL` — default chat model
* `MODEL_PLATFORM_TYPE` — `openai` (default) or `gemini` (Google native SDK; needed because Gemini 3 thinking models fail on the compatible endpoint without `thought_signature` round-trip)
* `MODEL_API_PROXY` — HTTP proxy, leave empty for direct connection

**Embedding service**

* `MODEL_EMBEDDING_MODEL` — default embedding model
* `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_BASE` / `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` / `MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_PROXY` — may point to a different provider; any field left unset falls back to the LLM service config

> Note: when any `MODEL_*` variable above is set, the environment config replaces the `model_settings.yaml` platform list entirely (single-platform deployment). For multi-platform setups, leave all `MODEL_*` variables unset and configure `model_settings.yaml` instead.

No local models, model weights, or GPU runtimes are deployed. Reranker and multimodal capabilities are not included.

evidence.heading: 0. Requirements
evidence.text:
- Python 3.10+
- Node.js 20+ (Node 22, see `frontend/.nvmrc`), pnpm
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)

evidence.heading: 2. Configure environment variables
evidence.text:
```shell
# Data root directory (optional, defaults to the current directory)
export TOMECHAT_ROOT=/path/to/tomechat_data

# LLM service
export MODEL_API_KEY=your-api-key
export MODEL_API_BASE=https://api.openai.com/v1
export MODEL_CHAT_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini

# Embedding service (may use a different provider; unset MODEL_EMBEDDING_API_*
# fields fall back to the LLM service config above)
export MODEL_EMBEDDING_MODEL=text-embedding-3-small

# Optional: search engine chat (Tavily)
export TAVILY_API_KEY=your-tavily-key
```

The data directory and knowledge-base database schema are created automatically at `tomechat start` — no manual initialization needed.

🎬 Zack D Films AI Video Generator
Turn one question into a finished Zack D Films-style 3D animated explainer short.


  
  
  


  
  
  




---

**Zack D Films AI Video Generator** is an agent-native production pipeline for fast, curiosity-driven 3D shorts. Give your coding agent one topic and it can plan the story, build consistent character and anatomy references, render stylized keyframes, animate them, generate narration, and assemble a vertical `final.mp4` with punchy edits.

It runs through the **MuAPI platform** (`api.muapi.ai`) with local **Python** and **ffmpeg**, and can be used from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, or any agent that can follow `SKILL.md`.

> **Ask your agent:** “Make me a Zack D Films-style short explaining what happens when you swallow gum.”

evidence.heading: ✨ Why it works
evidence.text:
The pipeline turns a fragmented production process into one agent-guided workflow:

- **Curiosity-first scripts** — hooks, open loops, fast pacing, and a clear payoff.
- **Consistent 3D worlds** — character turnarounds and anatomy references anchor every shot.
- **Signature visual language** — plasticine-like materials, subsurface scattering, dramatic studio light, macro depth of field, and internal cross-sections.
- **High-retention editing** — push-ins on impact beats, short fade/wipe/slide transitions, voice-led pacing, music, and captions.
- **Human approval at the right moments** — review the beat map and visual direction before the expensive generation stages.
- **Agent-native by design** — the workflow, prompts, and conventions live in `SKILL.md` and `references/`.

evidence.heading: 🎨 The look
evidence.text:
The visual target is a polished, stylized 3D educational short: expressive digital characters, smooth clay/plastic materials, high-contrast lighting, vibrant rim light, cinematic depth of field, and anatomical or mechanical cutaways that make invisible processes visible.

The style is established in the **keyframe stage** first. Motion is layered on afterward, so the look stays coherent from shot to shot.

evidence.heading: 🔄 How it works
evidence.text:
One topic flows through a single `beats.json` project:

```
topic / question
  │
  ├─ 1. Trend research       Find curiosity-driven questions and hooks
  ├─ 2. Script breakdown      Write the beat map              ◀── GATE 1: approve
  ├─ 3. Character sheets      Build multi-angle 3D references
  ├─ 4. Keyframes             Render stylized 3D scene posters  ◀── GATE 2: choose look
  ├─ 5. Motion clips           Animate each keyframe with Veo 3.1
  ├─ 6. Voice narration        Synthesize the narration and BGM
  ├─ 7. Assembly               Add impact zooms, transitions, mix audio, captions
  └─ final.mp4                Vertical 9:16 short
```

evidence.heading: 安装
evidence.text:
需要已安装的 [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)、pnpm 和本机 ComfyUI，Node.js 22 及以上。

| 插件版本 | 支持的 dsh 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.5.13`–`0.5.18` | `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2` |
| `0.5.12` | `0.2.0-rc.2` |

插件通过 `engines.dsh` 和 DSH peer dependencies 同时声明已验证的宿主版本，兼容新旧宿主的检查方式。其他 DSH 版本需要另行验证；升级后若提示版本不兼容，请先更新插件。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mangfufu/dsh-comfyui-web
```

evidence.heading: 从 DSH 启动本机 ComfyUI（Windows）
evidence.text:
只打开 DSH 时，ComfyUI 面板会显示本机启动入口。点击 **自动检测**，或用 **选择文件夹 / 选择启动文件** 打开 Windows 文件选择窗口；也可以手动填写绝对路径。支持任意名称的 `.exe` 启动器、`.bat` / `.cmd` / `.ps1` 启动脚本、`.lnk` 快捷方式，以及 ComfyUI 目录 / `main.py`，不限制启动器品牌，也不要求启动器旁边存在 ComfyUI 源码。

- **直接启动 ComfyUI**：使用安装目录里的 Python（支持 AKi、Windows 便携包和本地 `.venv` / `venv`），按面板配置的本机地址和端口启动。服务就绪后面板自动连接。
- **使用启动器或脚本**：使用自己的启动器、脚本或快捷方式，保留原有启动流程；如果打开的是启动器界面，请在其中点击启动。快捷方式保留其目标参数和工作目录。服务地址和端口需与面板设置一致，服务就绪后 DSH 自动连接。

自动检测只检查已配置路径、常见安装位置和带启动特征的文件名；手动选择文件不限制名称，选择文件夹会列出其中的启动文件。检测不会运行程序。点击启动后会保存入口；仅在识别出 ComfyUI 安装目录时配置桥接扩展，独立启动器沿用已有桥接配置。已运行或正在启动时不会重复启动。启动日志位于 `~/.dsh/comfyui/launch.log`，快捷方式目标程序的日志由目标程序管理。PowerShell 脚本遵循本机执行策略，失败时可查看日志。直接启动不会读取第三方启动器的自定义参数。远程 / Docker 地址仍需在对应环境中启动服务。




首次安装时，填写 ComfyUI 前端目录

创建或编辑 `~/.dsh/comfyui/config.json`，将示例中的前端目录替换为本机实际路径。Windows 的 `~` 是用户目录；Linux 同样填写实际路径。

```json
{
  "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8188",
  "frontendExtensionsDir": "D:/ComfyUI/python/Lib/site-packages/comfyui_frontend_package/static/extensions"
}
```

首次安装或更新后，先保存工作流，再刷新已打开的 ComfyUI 原网页和 dsh 内的面板。
目录未配置或写入失败时，面板的 **连接设置**和 dsh 启动日志会提示原因。能看到 ComfyUI 网页，还需等到 **AI 已连接** 才能让 AI 操作。




Docker / WSL 中的 ComfyUI

推荐使用已经持久化挂载的 `custom_nodes` 目录。编辑运行 dsh 的系统中的 `~/.dsh/comfyui/config.json`：

```json
{
  "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8188",
  "customNodesDir": "/mnt/data/ai/comfyui/storage-nodes/custom_nodes"
}
```

上面是 Linux 路径示例。**dsh 在 Windows 运行时，应填写 Windows 能写入的路径**，例如 `D:/ComfyUI/custom_nodes`，或实际 WSL 发行版的共享目录 `//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/mnt/data/ai/comfyui/storage-nodes/custom_nodes`。

确认对应宿主目录已挂载到容器的 `custom_nodes`，例如：

```yaml
volumes:
  - /mnt/data/ai/comfyui/storage-nodes/custom_nodes:/root/ComfyUI/custom_nodes
```

启动 dsh 后会生成 `dsh-comfyui-bridge` 扩展。先保存工作流，再重启 ComfyUI、刷新 dsh 面板。扩展保存在挂载目录中，容器重建后仍保留。

`customNodesDir` 与 `frontendExtensionsDir` 二选一。如果沿用前端目录方式，目录同样必须是 **

2. 启动 `dsh web`，打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`。
3. 进入对话，点击右上角 **ComfyUI**。



左边聊需求，右边改节点、看预览。手动编辑和 AI 操作都落在当前工作流上。

evidence.heading: 2. 确认连接地址
evidence.text:
默认连接 `http://127.0.0.1:8188`。如果更换了端口，打开 **连接设置**，修改地址后点击 **保存并连接**。



MCP 默认开启，dsh 已自动接入。这里也能关闭 MCP，或复制配置给其他本机 AI 客户端使用。

evidence.heading: 3. 让 AI 操作工作流
evidence.text:
直接在当前对话里告诉 AI：

> 读取当前工作流，优化正向提示词，保留现有模型和节点连接，生成一张图并查看效果。



提示词直接写入当前节点，右侧查看生成预览，左侧查看出图结果。AI 做了哪些修改，画布上实时可见。
工作流较大时，AI 默认先读取结构摘要，再按需读取节点参数，减少对话上下文占用。

通过插件提交生成后，图片和视频会自动显示在发起任务的回复正文下方，不需要 AI 额外调用显示工具；收起工具过程后仍可查看。
多张图片同样按原比例显示，空间不够时自动换行，不会缩成小方块。
同一路图片同时接标准保存和 Preview 节点时，对话只展示保存版；不同分支的图片和只有 Preview 的结果仍正常展示。
已有历史结果也可以让 AI「用插件显示这个图片或视频」。

也可以直接说「列出工作流标签页，切换到 XXX」，或「复制当前工作流，另开一个叫测试的标签页」。已保存的工作流也能打开或复制，源工作流和未保存修改会保留。

更多操作直接在对话里说：

- 「用我刚上传的参考图做图生图，填入图片节点。」
- 「加一个放大节点，接到输出前面。」
- 「保存当前工作流」，或「另存为视频测试」。另存遇到同名文件会提示换名称。
- 「列出修改快照，恢复到这次修改之前。」撤销、重做和快照在同一浏览器刷新后仍可使用；最多保留 20 份，实际数量受浏览器存储空间限制。
- 「查看我的生成任务，取消还没开始的那一个。」排队任务可按任务取消；中断正在生成的任务会影响整个实例当前生成。

生成完成会自动通知原对话，正在进行的回复不会被强行中断。
在 ComfyUI 手动停止后，AI 会收到“主动中断”通知；同一对话收到你的新消息前，插件会拦截再次提交。想继续时，明确告诉 AI「继续生成」。
极简预设也支持完成通知：缺少后台任务控制器时，插件会在当前会话内自动启用，无需手改配置。
插件重启会恢复原任务跟踪和结果；原对话的 AI 恢复运行后，会重新接上尚未送达的完成通知，不会重复提交生成。

想撤销就说「撤销刚才的修改」。界面大小用顶部 `− / +` 调整，点击 **刷新** 可重新加载 ComfyUI。

顶部 **图片对话中模糊** 开关默认关闭，同时适用于视频。开启后，点击模糊图先显示清晰图片，再点可查看大图；视频先解除模糊，再用播放按钮播放。鼠标悬停时，左上角的灰色小眼睛可切换模糊/清晰。关闭开关后，不出现模糊提示和小眼睛。只影响本插件返回到对话中的图片和视频，开关会记住。

evidence.text:
- **最多 9 人**：添加人物后，使用不同颜色的编号按钮切换角色，分别调整动作、站位和体型。
- **9 张人物图**：输入 1–9 按编号对应编辑器中的人物，自动生成身份与姿势对应提示词。
- **三种操作模式**：移动人物站位、调整人物关节、移动／旋转观察视角。
- **键盘控制**：左右键转身，上下键前后移动，按住 Shift 微调。
- **209 张 OpenPose 骨架图**：点击一键摆姿；支持导入自己的骨架图片、保存与读取姿势。
- **工作流保存**：人物姿势、体型、位置和已应用的姿势参考图随工作流保存。

> 编辑器支持 9 人，并不代表生成模型能保证每次严格输出 9 个正确身份。复杂多人场景仍可能出现额外人物、身份重复或动作偏差，具体限制见下文。

evidence.heading: 安装
evidence.text:
需要能够使用 `TextEncodeQwenImage21` 的 ComfyUI 版本，以及支持 WebGL 的浏览器。

在 ComfyUI 的 `custom_nodes` 目录执行：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/GStaaaaa/ComfyUI-Gaoshang-Pose.git
```

也可以在 [Releases](https://github.com/GStaaaaa/ComfyUI-Gaoshang-Pose/releases) 下载安装 ZIP，解压后把 `ComfyUI-Gaoshang-Pose` 文件夹放入 `custom_nodes`。

1. 保持文件夹名称为 **`ComfyUI-Gaoshang-Pose`**。使用 GitHub 的“Download ZIP”时，需要去掉解压目录末尾的 `-main`。
2. 完全重启 ComfyUI，然后在浏览器按 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 刷新。
3. 搜索 **“高尚姿势编辑器”** 添加节点，或拖入 [示例工作流](workflows)。

NumPy、Pillow 和 PyTorch 通常已随 ComfyUI 安装。若报缺少依赖，使用 **ComfyUI 自己的 Python 环境**执行：

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

人体数据、前端依赖与 209 张骨架图已随插件附带。首次下载约 100 MB；不要删除 `web/vnccs/assets/pose_studio_makehuman.v2.bin`。

evidence.heading: 模型与示例工作流
evidence.text:
插件不包含生成模型权重。示例工作流使用：

| 组件 | 示例文件 | 放置位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen Image 2.1 主模型 | `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors` | `models/diffusion_models` |
| 文本编码器 | `qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors` | `models/text_encoders` |
| VAE | `qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors` | `models/vae` |
| 姿势 LoRA | `VNCCS_QI2_PoseStudioV1.1.safetensors` | `models/loras` |

这些是示例所用文件名。请在各加载器中重新选择自己安装的兼容模型，并在“加载图片”节点上传自己的参考图。模型与 LoRA 的安装资料可参阅 [原项目说明](https://github.com/Work-Fisher/ComfyUI-Fisher-Pose)。

推荐从 [高尚-1-9人自由姿势编辑.json](workflows/高尚-1-9人自由姿势编辑.json) 开始。这个工作流以单人起步，后续可以添加到 9 人。

evidence.heading: 使用方法
evidence.text:
1. 连接 `clip`、`vae` 和 **1号人物图片**，点击 **“打开高尚姿势编辑器”**。
2. 点击 **“添加人物”**，再通过彩色编号切换要编辑的人物。
3. 摆好每个人物的动作、大小与站位。需要整体放入输出画面时，点击 **“全部排入画框”**。
4. 点击 **“应用到节点”**。回到工作流，按编号连接同样数量的人物图片。
5. 设置输出尺寸与场景描述，然后运行工作流。

evidence.heading: 操作方式
evidence.text:
| 模式 / 操作 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 移动人物站位 | 鼠标左键拖动当前人物整体位置 |
| 调整人物关节 | 拖动关节调整动作 |
| 移动／旋转相框 | 左键旋转观察视角，右键或中键平移，滚轮缩放 |
| 移动模式下的 ← / → | 人物转身，每次 5° |
| 移动模式下的 ↑ / ↓ | 远离／靠近镜头 |
| Shift + 方向键 | 微调人物移动或转身 |
| 回到正面视角 | 恢复正面观察视角 |

“移动／旋转相框”改变编辑时的观察视角；模型使用的是输出画框中的正面姿势图。编辑器中的人偶图尺寸与节点最终生成尺寸可以分别设置。

evidence.heading: 已知限制
evidence.text:
多人编辑功能已支持 1–9 人，但生成效果由模型、LoRA、参考图片与采样参数共同决定。**目前没有严格锁定输出人数、身份或关节位置的机制。**

实测五人场景中，即使输入与提示词人数正确，也可能生成六人；降低 LoRA 强度可能减少多余人物，同时削弱动作。仅强化人数提示词、合并身份图等办法尚未稳定解决这个问题。本版本保留稳定编辑器功能，没有默认启用这些实验方案。

2D OpenPose 图片不包含可靠的前后深度，导入后可能需要手动调整关节、转身与遮挡关系。

evidence.text: 基于 LangGraph 的 AI 旅行规划：对话补全需求、地图与交通查询、约束优化、可视化行程和持久化任务。

evidence.heading: 从一句旅行想法，到可以继续推敲的完整行程
evidence.text:
聊清目的地与偏好，让 Agent 查资料、排路线、检查时间。
在同一个工作区查看执行进度、浏览地图，并继续调整你的旅行计划。





[](LICENSE)

[功能](#features) · [界面展示](#screenshots) · [快速开始](#quick-start) · [工作原理](#architecture) · [配置](#configuration)

evidence.heading: 能做什么
evidence.text:
| 能力 | 使用体验 |
| --- | --- |
| **边聊边补齐旅行需求** | 描述目的地、日期、天数与偏好，主 Agent 通过受控工具整理规划需求，必要时继续询问。 |
| **查真实地点，再安排行程** | 查询高德景点、天气与交通信息，由候选生成、确定性优化和质量检查共同完成规划。 |
| **看得到任务正在做什么** | 展示规划与工具执行进度；任务、事件和结果持久化，支持 SSE 事件回放、取消和重试。 |
| **对照行程与地图浏览** | 在详情工作区切换日期，联动查看当天安排、地点资料、图片与地图位置。 |
| **生成以后继续改** | 通过对话提出调整，也可进入编辑界面修改地点、时间与顺序，保留行程版本关系。 |
| **记住有用的旅行偏好** | 管理旅行画像，压缩较早对话，整理可复用的长期记忆，为后续规划提供上下文。 |

evidence.heading: 行程、地点与地图一起看
evidence.text: 截图来自这个仓库的独立部署，使用示例账号和示例出行需求。页面中的地图、天气和地点信息受服务商数据及 Key 权限影响；规划结果不构成预订，也不保证实时营业、价格或交通情况。

evidence.heading: 快速开始
evidence.text: 需要 Docker Engine / Desktop、Docker Compose，以及你自己的模型和高德 API Key。

evidence.heading: 1. 获取代码
evidence.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/sagiri942/WAygent.git
cd WAygent
cp .env.example .env
```

Windows PowerShell 最后一行使用 `Copy-Item .env.example .env`。

evidence.heading: 工作原理
evidence.text:
主 Agent 使用 ReAct 工具调用，负责理解用户意图、读取上下文、维护规划需求和提交任务。完整行程生成由 LangGraph 规划流程执行：天气与地点检索 → 候选生成 → 确定性优化 → 交通检查 → 质量检查 → 保存结果。模型负责语义理解和候选组织，程序负责可计算的约束与结果校验。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    U[React 旅行工作区] --> API[FastAPI / 登录与会话]
    API --> CHAT[ReAct 主 Agent / 受控工具]
    CHAT --> B[PlanningBrief / 结构化需求]
    B --> RUN[持久化 Run / 单节点调度]
    RUN --> GRAPH[LangGraph 规划与修改流程]
    GRAPH --> MAP[高德 POI / 天气 / 交通]
    GRAPH --> OPT[确定性优化 / 质量检查]
    OPT --> DB[(MySQL / 账号、对话、行程)]
    RUN --> CP[(MySQL / LangGraph checkpoints)]
    CHAT --> MEM[对话压缩 / 长期记忆]
    MEM --> DB
    MAP --> CACHE[(Redis 缓存)]
    RUN --> SSE[SSE / 进度与结果回放]
    SSE --> U
```

| 位置 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `app/chat/` | 主 Agent、受控工具、需求整理与对话上下文 |
| `app/planning/` | 规划图、候选构建、优化、质量检查和行程修改 |
| `app/runtime/` | Run 状态、调度、事件、交互恢复与 checkpoints |
| `app/providers/` | 地图等外部服务适配 |
| `app/core/` | 认证、业务存储、记忆、缓存和通用能力 |
| `app/api/` | HTTP / SSE 接口 |
| `frontend/` | React 页面、样式、地图交互与本地静态构建产物 |
| `migrations_mysql/` | 业务数据库迁移 |
| `app/bootstrap.py`、`scripts/start.py` | 空环境初始化与容器启动 |

evidence.heading: 发布范围与运行边界
evidence.text:
- 仓库保留 Web 应用、提示词、评分配置、必要静态资源、第三方许可和部署文件，不携带真实账号、对话、行程、数据库、密钥、开发文档或测试评测集。
- 当前采用单应用进程和单节点 Runtime；多个副本同时连接同一套状态存储的调度一致性未作保证。
- 部分景点缺少图片或评分时，页面会显示占位或按规划规则处理；地图可用性取决于高德 Key 的权限与部署域名设置。
- 真实业务数据应做好备份；服务商调用失败、限额和网络情况会影响任务完成。

github_projects.name: agent-formal-verify
github_projects.description: TLA+ model checking and Lean proofs for coding agents, with explicit tool setup.
github_projects.description_zh: 用于编码智能体的 TLA+ 模型检查和 Lean 证明，以及明确的工具设置。

evidence.heading: 仓库简介
evidence.text: TLA+ model checking and Lean proofs for coding agents, with explicit tool setup.

evidence.heading: Agent formal verify
evidence.text:
A skill for Claude Code, Codex and Pi that implements the targeted formal-verification method [recently promoted by Boris Cherny](https://x.com/bcherny/status/2102543349102338309). The agent models selected parts of your code, checks their properties, maps counter-examples to source lines, and helps reproduce and fix reachable bugs.

It uses TLA+ and TLC for thread interleavings, shutdown and resource ownership, and Lean 4 for arithmetic, bounds and sequential state transitions. A protocol that depends on arithmetic can use both. For Rust functions with bounded inputs and loops, Kani checks the production code for overflow, invalid memory access, panics and broken invariants.

evidence.heading: Claude Code
evidence.text:
Run in Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/agent-formal-verify
/plugin install agent-formal-verify@agent-formal-verify
```

evidence.heading: Codex
evidence.text:
Run in your terminal:

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/agent-formal-verify
codex plugin add agent-formal-verify@agent-formal-verify
```

evidence.heading: Pi
evidence.text:
Run in your terminal:

```shell
pi install git:github.com/michael-denyer/agent-formal-verify
```

Run `setup` once to prepare the shared Java, Python, TLC, elan, Lean, Rust and Kani tools. In Claude Code, use `/agent-formal-verify:setup`. In Codex, request the plugin's `setup` skill. In Pi, use `/skill:setup`. It reuses installed prerequisites and needs no target repository.

For local checkouts and skills-only installs, see [shared installation](docs/reference.md#shared-installation).

evidence.heading: Getting started
evidence.text:
```text
Use formal-verify to check this queue's shutdown protocol and window arithmetic.
```

In Claude Code, use `/agent-formal-verify:formal-verify`. In Codex, type `$formal-verify` or request the plugin's `formal-verify` skill. In Pi, use `/skill:formal-verify`.

evidence.heading: How it works
evidence.text:
The agent selects risky code, builds TLA+ or Lean models or adds Kani harnesses that call the Rust code, and checks their properties. Reachable counter-examples guide reproductions and fixes to both the code and model. Mutation checks test whether the properties detect mistakes, and CI reruns the models as the code changes.

A passing check establishes its stated properties under its assumptions and bounds. Reports must identify omitted constraints and unfinished proofs. See [scope and evidence](docs/reference.md#scope-and-evidence).

github_projects.name: dsh-cockpit
github_projects.description: Live command deck for DeepSeek Harness agent teams: roster telemetry, task board, approvals, write actions, built-in Windows desktop capsule, and phone access.
github_projects.description_zh: DeepSeek 驱动的智能体团队实时指挥平台：人员名单遥测、任务板、审批、写入操作、内置 Windows 桌面模块以及手机访问。

evidence.heading: 仓库简介
evidence.text: Live command deck for DeepSeek Harness agent teams: roster telemetry, task board, approvals, write actions, built-in Windows desktop capsule, and phone access.

evidence.heading: Cockpit · 指挥台
evidence.text:
[](https://github.com/zoe1nan/dsh-cockpit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**一眼看清一支 AI 编队正在做什么。**

DeepSeek Harness 支持多个 agent 并行干活。但当一支编队跑起来，你会同时面对一串会话、一堆待办、若干子代理的实时动作，以及偶尔撞车的文件写域。Cockpit 把这些收进一块实时面板：编队在干嘛、计划走到第几步、任务板卡在哪、谁刚写了什么文件——并且允许你在同一个界面里做决定：审批、发话、中断。



从 v0.2 起它**内嵌在 DSH 工作台里**：侧栏点一下「Cockpit 指挥台」，页面就在主区打开，不用另开浏览器标签、不用记端口。独立 URL 也保留，方便第二块屏或手机。







---

evidence.heading: 看
evidence.text:
- **实时编队**：每个成员的模型、真实 token 数、当前动作、负责范围（自动从任务主题/改动文件归纳）；按运行中 / 空闲 / 异常分组，运行中永远在前
- **任务板**：共享任务、状态列、依赖关系（`blockedBy`）、两人的写域重叠会被标成「双写风险」
- **计划兜底**：没有共享任务板时，自动用本轮 todo 计划铺满任务板，永远不空
- **实时流**：工具调用说人话（`运行命令` / `编辑文件` / `搜索内容` …），参数一行省略、点击展开
- **本轮数据**：进度、token、耗时、步骤、模型、状态，液面进度条随事件实时更新
- **会话切换**：点左栏会话或顶部 pill 即切换，每个标签页记住自己的选择；顶栏「复制链接」给出可分享的视图链接，别人打开就落在同一个会话（v1.1）
- **自检与诊断**：设置页一键自检（插件 / 状态数据 / 实时流 / 胶囊 / HUD 数据桥 / 远程 / 待审批 / 宿主接口），异常一眼可见，可复制完整报告发给维护者（v1.1）
- **设置页重排**：连接/设备 → 胶囊 → 自检 → 通知 → 别名 → 关于，卡头与说明统一，窄屏同序（v1.2）
- **反馈一致**：成功/提醒/失败用同一套语气与停留时长，失败文案直接给出下一步（v1.2）
- **实时流降噪**：连续同类工具调用折叠为「×N」，空参数不再占一行（v1.2）

evidence.heading: 操作
evidence.text:
- **审批闸口**：审批请求直接出现在指挥台里，允许一次 / 拒绝；25 秒不处理自动交回原生弹窗
- **发消息**：对某个 agent 排队送达，或「插入」打断当前轮立刻插话
- **中断**：行内确认后停止正在跑的轮
- **所有写操作**：同源校验、失败回滚、本地审计（`~/.dsh/cockpit/audit.jsonl`）

evidence.heading: 桌面胶囊（Windows）
evidence.text: 装一个插件就有桌面悬浮胶囊：液体进度条 + 步骤读数 + 「N 跑 · M 批」徽标；点击展开完整卡片，可一键打开指挥台。胶囊跟随**任意正在运行的会话**（1.0.1 起：谁在干活就显示谁，多个同时运行时跟随你最近输入的那个，空下来回到「待命」），不再只盯着指挥台会话。v1.1 起点击胶囊本体直接打开指挥台（有待审批时直接落在审批区），右上箭头才展开/收起卡片；v1.2 起胶囊 hover 有描边高亮，待审批时描边转琥珀色。胶囊进程由插件托管（自动启动/退出/崩溃重启），设置页可启停。

evidence.heading: 手机 / 远程
evidence.text:
- 局域网一次性配对码（6 位、2 分钟有效、单次使用、错误限速），手机浏览器即可接管
- 需要 HTTPS 时给出隧道向导（检测 cloudflared / Tailscale，只给命令，不替你执行）
- 公网 HTTPS 地址 + Secure Cookie；配对设备可随时撤销
- 审批到达时（页面在后台）可发系统通知
- PWA：可安装、离线外壳、断网提醒

evidence.heading: 安装
evidence.text:
前置：DeepSeek Harness（带插件系统与客户端模块）、Node.js ≥ 22；**桌面胶囊仅 Windows 10 2004+**，其他平台指挥台正常、胶囊自动隐藏。

1. 下载 `dsh-cockpit-<version>.tgz`（Releases 或本地 `npm pack`）
2. 安装到你的 profile 并重启：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-cockpit-1.2.2.tgz
```

3. 重启 DSH 后：侧栏出现「Cockpit 指挥台」，点开即用；桌面胶囊随宿主自动启动（Windows）。

独立访问：`http://127.0.0.1:<DSH 端口>/cockpit/`。

升级：重复 `add` 新版本 tgz 后重启；设置与别名保存在 `~/.dsh/cockpit/`，升级不丢。
卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-cockpit`，再重启。

---

evidence.heading: 已知限制
evidence.text:
- 桌面胶囊仅 Windows；macOS / Linux 只有指挥台
- PWA 安装与系统通知要求安全上下文（HTTPS 或 localhost）；局域网 HTTP 只能当网页用（设置页会提示）
- 后台 Web Push 尚未实现，当前只有前台/系统通知
- DSH 团队模型只增不减：同一会话里 teammate 无法删除，Cockpit 用折叠分组保持界面干净

---

**Turn hypotheses into experiments, experiments into evidence, and evidence into auditable conclusions.**

evidence.heading: Full setup example
evidence.text:
Register the five servers with your MCP client, then start the stack:

```bash
# see which clients are supported, preview without writing
gnosislab setup --list
gnosislab setup claude-code --dry-run    # or opencode, vscodium, vscode,
                                         # windsurf, cursor

# merge the server entries into the client's MCP config
gnosislab setup claude-code

# background all five servers (upstreams first)
gnosislab start all

# pid/ports/health per server
gnosislab status

# resolved ports + config file path
gnosislab config

# tail one server's log
gnosislab logs episteme

# open the lab status dashboard in your browser (agora by default)
gnosislab dashboard            # → ML_AGORA_GUI_URL (default http://localhost:28051)
gnosislab dashboard episteme   # any server's GUI works too

# stop everything (consumers first)
gnosislab stop all
```

Ports resolve as: built-in defaults < `~/.config/gnosislab/ports.env` <
environment variables — same `KEY=VALUE` format as the repo's
`ports.env`. Runtime state always lives in `~/.ml-<name>/`, regardless
of install method. The dashboard URL comes from the resolved
`ML_<NAME>_GUI_URL`, so remote/VM setups can point it at a reachable
host without editing scripts.

**Full documentation:** <https://loop.cloudcell.workers.dev/docs>

evidence.heading: Install from source
evidence.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/cloudcell/gnosislab.git
cd gnosislab
uv sync
./gnosislab start all
```

> **Sealed trial execution needs Linux tooling.** The executor isolates
> trials with `bubblewrap` mount namespaces and traces reads with
> `strace`. Neither exists on Windows (or macOS) — there is no bwrap
> package to install. With the default `sandbox = "auto"`, trials on
> those platforms **fail closed** rather than silently running
> unsealed. To run trials without isolation, opt out explicitly in
> `~/.ml-episteme/config.toml`:
>
> ```toml
> [executor]
> sandbox = "none"
> ```
>
> (equivalently, `ML_EPISTEME_SANDBOX=none`). If you also configure
> `[executor] sealed_path_patterns`, add
> `sealed_enforcement = "audit"` — `deny` needs a mount namespace to
> arm. Coding agents often offer to "disable sandboxing" when they hit
> this error; the knob they should set is `sandbox`, shown above.
>
> On Debian/Ubuntu the full experience is:

```bash
sudo apt install bubblewrap strace
```

evidence.heading: How it works
evidence.text:
GnosisLab is composed of five MCP services.

| Service | Role | Think of it as |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Episteme** | experiments, trials, observations and experimental state | the laboratory notebook |
| **Anamnesis** | claims, evidence relationships and persistent research memory | the evidence graph |
| **Zetesis** | search, investigation campaigns and evidence discovery | the investigator |
| **Arete** | improvement, comparison and meta-level adaptation | the critic / improver |
| **Agora** | coordination and lab-level observability | the control room |

The services deliberately keep their state boundaries separate. This makes ownership clearer, failures easier to isolate, schemas easier to evolve, and each subsystem independently inspectable.

evidence.heading: How GnosisLab compares
evidence.text:
Against adjacent systems, including autonomous-research agents, agent frameworks, reproducibility tools, and experiment trackers, GnosisLab is distinguished not by any single capability but by their integration: scientific objects are represented as first-class state, methodological constraints are enforced at runtime, execution provenance is bound to the research record, and the stored record is reconciled against what actually executed.



**Legend:** ✓ = native or core capability; ◐ = partial, indirect, configurable, or implementation-dependent; — = not a core capability or not evidenced in the compared system.

The comparison is intended to distinguish architectural emphasis rather than overall system capability. Systems such as autoresearch, EvoScientist, and AutoGPT are primarily designed to increase autonomous task or experiment execution, whereas GnosisLab places greater emphasis on representing and verifying the scientific process itself.

evidence.heading: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
evidence.text:
[](https://little-fridge.github.io/ViewCraft-page/)
[](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15915)
[](skill-library/README.md)

Binxiao Xu · Ruichuan An · Bocheng Zou · Weihua Du · Xinyu Wei
Hangyu Guo · YiFan Zhang · Renye Yan · Chengqi Duan · Hang Hua

[Quickstart](#quickstart) · [Method](#method) · [Skills](#skill-library) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [Citation](#citation)

Python 3.11+   ·   MIT License   ·   Frozen executor weights



---

ViewCraft evolves **what a multimodal agent sees and how it reads the evidence**.
It learns observation selection, visual transformations, layout and reading
instructions together, then exports them as a reusable skill. Model weights stay fixed.

| Eight benchmarks | Matched input-token budget | Five multi-source tasks |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **+6.1** mean task-score points vs. Direct | **+5.2** points vs. token-matched Direct | **8–15%** fewer input tokens vs. Initial skill |

Results reported in the paper's benchmark evaluation; see [release scope](docs/release.md) for artifact details.

evidence.heading: Quickstart
evidence.text:
Python **3.11+** on Linux or macOS. A hosted vision-model endpoint needs no local GPU.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Little-Fridge/ViewCraft.git
cd ViewCraft
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# Validate the bundled evolution example without model calls.
python scripts/evolve.py --task examples/counting/task.yaml --check
```

Configure image-capable executor and optimizer models:

```bash
export OPENAI_API_KEY='your-key'
export VIEWCRAFT_ENDPOINT='https://your-server/v1/chat/completions'
export VIEWCRAFT_EXECUTOR_MODEL='your-vision-executor-model'
export VIEWCRAFT_OPTIMIZER_MODEL='your-vision-optimizer-model'
```

Use a skill on your own image:

```bash
python scripts/use_skill.py \
  --skill dense-counting \
  --images your-image.png \
  --question 'How many target objects are visible? Give region subtotals.'
```

For PDFs or videos, install `requirements-media.txt` and pass the original file:

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements-media.txt
python scripts/use_skill.py --skill pdf-reading --pdf report.pdf \
  --question 'Summarize the main findings with page references.'
```

Or evolve a skill and evaluate it on held-out items:

```bash
python scripts/evolve.py --task examples/counting/task.yaml --run-id counting-demo
python scripts/evolve.py --task examples/counting/task.yaml --run-id counting-demo --stage test
```

Execution calls your configured model service. The small bundled example contains
6 train / 3 gate / 3 test items and runs two evolution rounds; it is a software
example, not a reproduction of the paper's benchmark tables.
See [configuration](docs/configuration.md) for endpoint options and
[the tutorial](docs/tutorial.md) to bring your own data.

evidence.heading: Method
evidence.text: SeeSelect observations, crops and visual transformations.VIEW.yaml ArrangeOrganize views, labels and context.LAYOUT.yaml ReadInspect, compare and reason from the evidence.SKILL.md Execution traces guide joint revisions. Visual replay and execution checks screen them; paired development evaluation decides what to retain. Eligible rejected joint edits can retry the proposed interface with the incumbent reader. The final snapshot is saved under `runs//arms/viewcraft/snapshots/final/`. Apply it to a new question: ```bash python scripts/predict.py \ --skill runs/counting-demo/arms/viewcraft/snapshots/final \ --images your-image.png \ --question 'How many target objects are visible?' \ --output prediction.json ```

evidence.heading: Skill library
evidence.text:
Ten ready-to-run task skills for documents, images and video.
Each includes reading instructions, observation settings and a view-context contract.

| Skill | What you can do |
| :--- | :--- |
| [PDF reading](skill-library/pdf-reading) | Locate cross-page evidence and answer with page references. |
| [Dense counting](skill-library/dense-counting) | Count by region without counting the same object twice. |
| [Spot differences](skill-library/spot-differences) | Find additions, removals, relocations and visual changes. |
| [Maze solving](skill-library/maze-solving) | Trace routes and verify each passage against the walls. |
| [Chart reading](skill-library/chart-reading) | Interpret series, axes, units and quantitative comparisons. |
| [Table extraction](skill-library/table-extraction) | Convert visual tables into CSV, JSON or Markdown. |
| [Document comparison](skill-library/document-comparison) | Align versions and identify changed values or clauses. |
| [Screenshot troubleshooting](skill-library/screenshot-troubleshooting) | Read visible errors and identify the next useful check. |
| [Video event localization](skill-library/video-event-localization) | Track actions and changes through timestamped frames. |
| [Diagram understanding](skill-library/diagram-understanding) | Follow arrows, branches, dependencies and loops. |

Run these skills directly on your files; no optimization stage is required. The runner accepts images, PDFs and videos, and saves the complete answer with its supporting evidence. [Commands and supported inputs →](skill-library/README.md)

evidence.heading: dsh-qwen-paint · (绘图)千问（优化版）
evidence.text:
面向 **DeepSeek Harness** 的本地图像生成插件。经由本机 **ComfyUI** 调用 **Qwen-Image 2.1** 模型，  
在对话中直接完成文生图与图生图；生成的图像落盘保存，并在会话界面内直接呈现。

**网络边界（请以本节为准）**：插件的网络出口有**两类，边界不同**。

**① 出图数据流**（提示词、参考图）—— 只发往 `comfyUrl`（ComfyUI）与 `hipfireUrl`（hipfire serve）。
**默认仅本机回环**（`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1`），且这一约束**由代码层强制**（`lib/net-guard.js`）：
任一地址被配成本机以外时，**插件会拒绝启动**而不是照发请求。所有出站请求统一走 `guardedFetch`，
强制 `redirect: 'error'`（不跟随任何 HTTP 重定向）。因此**出图全程不依赖外部网络，无需任何 API 密钥，亦不产生调用费用**。

**② 加速包下载**（可选，**默认开启**）—— `accelAutoInstall`（默认 `true`）时，插件会从 **pip 源与 GitHub**
下载厂商专用加速包（`pip install --upgrade` / `git clone`）。**这会访问外部地址**，
但**不发送任何提示词或图片**。设为 `accelAutoInstall: false` 即可完全关闭，出图功能不受影响。
详见下文「权限与已知风险」。

> ⚠ 为如实披露能力：插件提供了 `allowRemoteComfy` 开关（默认 `false`）。用户**显式**设为 `true` 后，
> 才可把 `comfyUrl` / `hipfireUrl` 指向局域网（如 `192.168.1.100`）或远程主机——此时插件会向你指定的地址发送提示词与图片数据。
> 这是**用户主动选择**的行为，不是默认状态。

> **原作者**：@奇迹与你（<https://github.com/wonderandyou/dsh-qwen-paint>）  
> **优化版作者**：@yanfei0725（<https://github.com/yanfei0725/dsh-qwen-paint>）　｜　**许可协议**：MIT　｜　**当前版本**：`0.17.13`

evidence.heading: 3. 那 15 项红灯的真因：测试过期，不是功能坏了
evidence.text:
0.17.8 的 AUTH001 整改把状态端点的写操作从「GET + 查询参数」改成了
「POST + JSON body」，而 `selftest.mjs` 里还在用老写法调用，被新守卫 405 挡住，
于是"改档位没生效"看起来像 bug。

- 实现与前端都是对的，只有测试过期。
- 修法：把测试的调用方式迁到 POST（**一条旧断言都没删改**，`git diff` 里被删的 `check(` 行数 = 0）。
- 另加一条新断言：**GET 带写参数必须被 405 挡住** —— 把"GET 只读"这条约束钉死。

evidence.heading: ② 隔离实测（不动正在使用的环境）
evidence.text:
用一次性目录装被测版本，并用 `$DSH_HOME` 指向临时目录做 profile 隔离
（DSH 的 profile / 配置 / 日志全部在 `$DSH_HOME` 下，因此**不会碰** `~/.dsh`）：

```
mkdir /tmp/dsh-a5 && cd /tmp/dsh-a5 && npm i --prefix . @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.5
DSH_TEST_INSTALL=/tmp/dsh-a5 node scripts/test-dsh-compat.mjs
```

evidence.heading: ④ 诚实边界（"compatible"在这里的准确含义）
evidence.text:
- 验证到的是 **manifest + patch + cordis 加载/注册链路**；**不含**端到端出图
  （出图还需要本机 ComfyUI 与模型权重，是另一件事）。
- 唯一的替身是 `systemPrompt`：完整 dsh app 才提供它，而该脚本刻意**不启动整个 app**
  （那会进入交互式 TUI 并需要登录），只挂载 `tools` 这一层；`tools` 本身是被测版本的真实实现。
- `0.2.1-alpha.3` / `alpha.4` 及其它未实测版本**保持 unknown**，不因为"同系列"就顺手写成兼容。

evidence.heading: ② 装包与 Shell 能力 —— 披露与实现对齐（**不改功能**）
evidence.text:
审核原文：
> README 权限表仍写"不装包"，但 `lib/index.js` 的 `runInstallSource` 会经 `runShell` 执行
> `pip install --upgrade`；`lib/config.js` 使用 PowerShell / `sh -c`。请对齐网络、装包与 Shell
> 能力的披露和实际确认边界，无需删掉正常功能或把真实信号标为 false。

**也属实，而且比"措辞不准"更严重**：`accelAutoInstall` **默认为 `true`**，
插件加载后会自动 `pip install --upgrade` / `git clone` 从 **pip 源与 GitHub** 下载厂商加速包。
这意味着 README 里"默认仅本机回环"的说法**本身也不完整** —— 装包是一条真实的**外部网络出口**。

本版按"如实披露 + 明确边界"处理（**不删功能**）：

- **权限表重写**：网络拆成**两类出口**（出图数据流 / 加速包下载），命令行如实写明
  `runShell` 走 PowerShell 或 `sh -c`、且默认会 `pip install` / `git clone`。
- **新增已知风险第 4 条**：明确 `accelAutoInstall: true`（默认）会装包、会出网、
  **不发送提示词或图片**，并给出**关闭方法**（`accelAutoInstall: false`，关掉后出图不受影响）。
- **顶部「网络边界」段落重写**为两类出口，不再用"不依赖外部网络"这种绝对化说法。
- **区分清楚"不下载什么"**：插件**不下载模型权重**、**不自动安装第三方自定义节点**
  （这两条原本就是事实，保留并写明确）。

evidence.heading: 图片是怎么显示在聊天框里的（原理，改之前务必看）
evidence.text:
这一节是 2026-10-07 逐个查内核源码核过的，**不要凭直觉改**：

| 路径                                                | 能用吗           | 原因（都有内核源码依据）                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ImageBlock`（工具结果里返 `{type:"image", attachment}`） | ✗             | 客户端 `imageCardModel()` 开头就是 `if (call?.name !== "read_image") return null` —— **只认 `read_image`**；其他工具的 image block 会被 generic 卡片用 `JSON.stringify` 当文本打印出来 |
| `presentCall` / `presentResult`                   | ✗             | ui-tool README 原文："Host `presentCall` and `presentResult` values **never enter the Client**."                                                               |
| `presentationMeta` 让图显示                           | ✗             | 它确实会落到 `tool/result` 的 `data.meta`，但客户端**只有** `read_image` 那张卡片读它、且只当路径标签用                                                                                  |

evidence.heading: 权限与已知风险（安装前请读）
evidence.text:
本插件**不是**纯只读插件 —— 它要调本机 ComfyUI 出图，因此**必然**需要文件、网络与子进程能力。
下面按 DSH 商城的口径逐项如实披露，**不隐瞒、不淡化**。

| 能力 | 本插件的实际情况 | 等级 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **文件（files）** | **读写**：读你给的参考图 / 控制图；把生成的图**写到你指定的目录**（默认桌面「千问1生图」）；读 ComfyUI 的模型清单与日志 | `write` |
| **网络（network）** | **两类出口，边界不同** —— ① **出图数据流**（提示词 / 图片）：发往 `comfyUrl`（ComfyUI）与 `hipfireUrl`（hipfire serve），**默认仅本机回环、由代码层强制**（`lib/net-guard.js`：非回环地址拒绝启动），可用 `allowRemoteComfy` 显式放开；② **加速包下载**（见下行「命令」）：`accelAutoInstall`（**默认 `true`**）时插件会从 **pip 源与 GitHub** 下载第三方加速包 —— **会访问外部地址**，但**不发送任何提示词或图片**，设为 `false` 可完全关闭。**无遥测、无上报** | `specified-services` |
| **命令（commands）** | **受限调用，但不止"只读探测"**：① 启动 / 探测本机 ComfyUI（`python main.py`）与 `nvidia-smi` / `rocm-smi` 只读探测；② **`runShell` 是系统命令的唯一入口**，Windows 走 `powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command`、Linux/macOS 走 `sh -c`；③ **`accelAutoInstall: true`（默认）时会执行 `pip install --upgrade` 与 `git clone` 安装白名单内的加速包**（见下）。子进程**传入过滤后的环境变量**（剔除代理与凭据类）。**不执行从网络下载后立刻运行的脚本**（下载的包由 ComfyUI 在重启后加载） | `restricted` |
| **凭据（credentials）** | **无**。不需要 API 密钥、不需要登录、不读写系统钥匙串 | `none` |
| **生命周期脚本** | **无** —— manifest 里没有 `preinstall` / `install` / `postinstall` / `prepare` | — |
| **运行依赖** | **零** —— 不 `import` 任何第三方包，纯 Node ESM | — |

综合等级：**medium**（能力范围明确，出图数据流**默认**限于本机，但确实会写文件、起进程、并在默认配置下装包）。
